<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperRoot, type StepperRootEmits, type StepperRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<StepperRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * `StepperItem` elements. Receives the active step.
   */
  default?: (props: { modelValue?: number }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="stepper"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    class="sigma-ui-stepper"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </StepperRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-stepper {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.sigma-ui-stepper[data-orientation="vertical"] {
  flex-direction: column;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperDescription, type StepperDescriptionProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperDescriptionProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Short explanation of the step.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperDescription
    data-slot="stepper-description"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    class="sigma-ui-stepper-description"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </StepperDescription>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-stepper-description {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperIndicator, type StepperIndicatorProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperIndicatorProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Step number or icon. Receives the current step index.
   */
  default?: (props: { step: number }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperIndicator
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="stepper-indicator"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    class="sigma-ui-stepper-indicator"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </StepperIndicator>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-stepper-indicator {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground) 50%, transparent);
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-item[data-disabled] .sigma-ui-stepper-indicator {
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-item[data-state="active"] .sigma-ui-stepper-indicator {
  background-color: var(--primary);
  color: var(--primary-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-item[data-state="completed"] .sigma-ui-stepper-indicator {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-foreground);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperItem, type StepperItemProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperItemProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Trigger, indicator, title, and separator. Receives the step state.
   */
  default?: (props: { state: 'completed' | 'active' | 'inactive' }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperItem
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="stepper-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    class="sigma-ui-stepper-item"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </StepperItem>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-stepper-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-item[data-disabled] {
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperSeparator, type StepperSeparatorProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperSeparatorProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <StepperSeparator
    data-slot="stepper-separator"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    class="sigma-ui-stepper-separator"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  />
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-stepper-separator {
  flex: 1;
  background-color: var(--muted);
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-separator[data-orientation="horizontal"] {
  height: 1px;
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-separator[data-orientation="vertical"] {
  width: 1px;
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-item[data-disabled] .sigma-ui-stepper-separator {
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.sigma-ui-stepper-separator[data-state="completed"] {
  background-color: var(--accent);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperTitle, type StepperTitleProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperTitleProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Name of the step.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperTitle
    data-slot="stepper-title"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    class="sigma-ui-stepper-title"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </StepperTitle>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-stepper-title {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { StepperTrigger, type StepperTriggerProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = defineProps<StepperTriggerProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Indicator and labels for one step.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <StepperTrigger
    data-slot="stepper-trigger"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...$attrs }"
    class="sigma-ui-stepper-trigger"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </StepperTrigger>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-stepper-trigger {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  gap: 0.25rem;
  text-align: center;
}
</style>
